name: prowl
description: Real-world market data for your agents: the Prowl skill backed by the hosted Prowl MCP server (444 market data tools across 17 providers), with a status widget that makes a running call, its progress and its cost visible in the terminal.

interface.shortDescription: Real-world market data for your agents
interface.longDescription: Connect the hosted Prowl MCP server to give any agent 444 market data tools across 17 providers – search, ads, SEO, app stores, reviews, social, trends and finance. Each call is billed on its own from one USD wallet, every number comes back with the tool that returned it, and prowl_analyze composes a cross-checked report when one call is not enough. Ships a status widget: an in-flight call and how long it has run, session spend from the server's own billing figures, async-session progress in the dock, and a one-time notice when a call fails or the wallet blocks one.
